openDecision.finding: At least terminal-retire directly demands the implicit promotion now forbidden. Making a hidden legacy branch preserve it would reintroduce the rejected semantic path.
openDecision.scope: Test API/preparation reconciliation only, not architecture/policy/security relaxation.

affectedCases.proof: Two Input(...commit=false) calls, then Retire, then State(longValue,true). No terminal snapshot, terminal event, generation/revision or ack is supplied.
affectedCases.conflict: New requirement 8 prohibits Retire committing an arbitrary last current solely due to retirement.

affectedCases.proof: Two Input(...commit=false) calls, then parameterless Checkpoint, then State(longValue,true).
affectedCases.conflict: Requirements 7/9 demand explicitly observed terminal snapshot + revision/generation/ack, not lookup of whatever pending contains.

affectedCases.proof: Intermediate editing values then parameterless Checkpoint; verifies all historical values protected and ordinary page text preserved.
affectedCases.conflict: No terminal snapshot supplied to updated live-checkpoint semantics; preparation needs reconciliation, security assertions must remain.

affectedCases.proof: Only uncommitted short Input, then expects Retire denial.
affectedCases.conflict: New requirement 8 permits preserving buffers as TRANSIENT without a terminal. To test true committed-short denial prospectively, a real explicit terminal must be supplied; no claim that this assertion necessarily fails under every allowed conservative implementation.

affectedCases.proof: Only uncommitted short Input then parameterless Checkpoint denial.
affectedCases.conflict: The inverse security test must demonstrate an observed true terminal snapshot, not generic missing-checkpoint evidence or arbitrary pending.

openDecision.requestedHumanAuthorization: Permit only scoped preparation/caller adaptation of these direct contracts to supply explicitly correlated terminal snapshot/generation/revision/ack as appropriate. Preserve all no-exposure, monotonicity, committed-short-denial and redaction assertions; preserve generated values; do not modify the three historical native scenarios, their driver/HTML/sleeps/assertions.

plannedSemantics.knownValues: Remember all truly observed buffers; no eviction; stale/duplicate events cannot regress current or terminal ownership.
plannedSemantics.revision: Producer-generated monotonic per-control revision, bound to exact document incarnation, not transport receipt timestamp.
plannedSemantics.generation: Opaque incarnation distinct from numeric executionContextId; retained exact old lifecycle correlation for late data; no heuristic rebind.
plannedSemantics.commit: Validate explicit snapshot ownership, observation witness, generation/control/revision and terminal reason; retain length 1..3 denial.
plannedSemantics.retire: Never mint terminal solely from current. Consume confirmed snapshot if present, otherwise preserve TRANSIENT or typed fail-closed if continuity required.
plannedSemantics.checkpoint: Exact native snapshot+revision/generation from current protected world with correlated ack; no parameterless pending fallback in productive path.

beforeAfterHashes: No source changes; before==after. See baseline and integrity.
